blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Product-centric advertisement video generation aims to create promotional videos that preserve fine-grained product identity while presenting selling points through coherent multi-shot narratives. However, this emerging task remains underexplored due to the lack of large-scale advertisement-specific datasets and comprehensive evaluation frameworks.
To address this gap, we introduce AdSpark , a large-scale dataset and benchmark for product-centric advertisement video generation, based on data from a major e-commerce platform. AdSpark-300K contains approximately 300K reference image–prompt–video triplets, comprising a real-world subset and a synthetic subset.
Each sample provides structured advertisement annotations, including product identity annotations, selling-point descriptions, creative plans, and aligned audio scripts, enabling models to learn product preservation and advertisement-oriented visual storytelling.
We further propose AdSpark-Bench , a diagnostic benchmark that evaluates generated advertisements across six dimensions, including visual quality, product fidelity, instruction adherence, temporal coherence, audio alignment, and advertisement effectiveness.
Based on AdSpark-Bench, we evaluate representative models, revealing key challenges in product preservation, multi-shot storytelling, and selling-point visualization.
Experiments with AdSpark-300K-finetuned models further validate the effectiveness of our dataset. AdSpark provides a unified dataset and benchmark for future research, and we will release the dataset upon acceptance.

blocks.en:
With the rapid growth of e-commerce and short-form video platforms, advertisement videos have become increasingly important for product promotion and digital marketing. However, traditional advertisement production requires professional designing and filming, making it labor-intensive and costly.
Recent advances in generative visual modeling, spanning reference-to-video generation Liu et al. (2025) ; Chen et al. (2026) ; Wang et al. (2026a) and 3D generation Yang et al. (2025) ; Yang et al. (2026a) ; Wang et al. (2025b) ; Lu et al. (2026b) ; Wang et al. (2025a) ; Lu et al. (2026a) , have enabled increasingly realistic, controllable, and scalable synthesis from visual or textual conditions, opening new opportunities for automated advertisement production.
blocks.zh:
随着电子商务和短式视频平台的快速发展,广告视频对产品推广和数字营销越来越重要. 然而,传统的广告制作需要专业的设计和拍摄,使其劳动密集型和昂贵.
遗传视觉模型学方面的最新进展,跨越了参考到视频生成的刘等 (2025年);陈等 (2026年);王等 (2026年a)和3D生成的杨等 (2025年);杨等 (2026年a) ; 杨等 (2026年a) ; 王等 (2025年b); 吕等 (2026年b); Wang et al. (2025a); Lu et al. (2026a),使得从视觉或文字条件来看,越来越现实,可控,可伸缩的合成,为自动化广告制作开辟了新的机会.

blocks.en:
Nevertheless, existing video generation models Song et al. (2026) ; Zhang et al. (2025) ; Yuan et al. (2026b) are primarily developed for general-purpose visual content generation, with an emphasis on visual quality, semantic alignment, and temporal coherence. In contrast, product-centric advertisement videos additionally require faithful preservation of fine-grained product identity and effective visualization of selling points through coherent multi-shot narratives. Achieving these goals involves coordinated control over scene composition, camera motion, shot transitions, and audio to create a compelling advertising experience.
Thus, current models Fang et al. (2023a) ; Fang et al. (2023b) ; Fan et al. () ; Song et al. (2026) ; HaCohen et al. (2026) still struggle with Product-Centric Advertisement Video Generation (PC-AVG) , leaving the task challenging and largely underexplored.

尽管如此,现有的视频生成模式 宋等 (2026年); 张等 (2025年); 袁等 (2026年b) 主要为通用视觉内容生成而开发,以视觉质量,语义相通,时间相通为主. 相反地,以产品为中心的广告视频还需要忠实地保存精细的产品特性,并通过连贯的多镜头叙事对销售点进行有效的可视化。 实现这些目标涉及对场景组成,相机运动,镜头过渡,以及音频的协调控制,以创造令人信服的广告体验.
因此,目前的模式 Fang等人(2023a); Fang等人(2023年b); 范等编. (); Song等 (2026); HaCohen等 (2026) 仍然与产品-Central Advication Video Crowth (PC-AVG)相争,使得任务具有挑战性并基本未得到充分探讨.

blocks.en: A major bottleneck is the lack of large-scale, high-quality datasets for PC-AVG. As summarized in Tab. 1 , existing video datasets are primarily developed for open-domain text-to-video generation Wang et al. (2023b) ; Chen et al. (2024) , image-to-video generation Wu et al. (2026) , or subject-to-video generation Yuan et al. (2026a) ; Zhang et al. (2026) . However, these datasets mainly consist of generic video–text pairs or reference-conditioned videos and are not specifically curated for advertising scenarios. Moreover, they rarely provide advertisement-specific annotations, such as product identity, selling points, and creative plans, limiting their effectiveness for adapting video generation models to PC-AVG.
blocks.zh: 一个主要瓶颈是PC-AVG缺乏大规模,高质量的数据集. 如Tab. 1所概述,现有的视频数据集主要是为开放域的文本到视频生成Wang等人(2023年b)开发的; 陈等 (2024),形象到视频生成. Wu等 (2026),或被主体到视频生成的袁等 (2026a); 张等 (2026). 然而,这些数据集主要由通用的视频-文本配对或参考条件的视频组成,并非专门用于广告情景。 此外,它们很少提供特定广告说明,如产品身份,销售点和创意计划等,限制了它们为PC-AVG改造视频生成模型的有效性.

blocks.en: Beyond training data, existing benchmarks are insufficient for evaluating PC-AVG. As shown in Tab. 2 , current benchmarks Huang et al. (2024) ; Yuan et al. (2026a) ; Yang et al. (2026b) mainly focus on general video generation capabilities, including visual quality, semantic alignment, and temporal coherence. However, these assessment frameworks overlook key advertisement-specific aspects, such as fine-grained product preservation, selling-point visualization, and advertisement effectiveness. This gap makes it difficult to evaluate whether generated videos not only achieve high perceptual quality, but also follow the intended advertisement design and effectively communicate commercial messages. Therefore, existing benchmarks cannot fully characterize the capabilities required for PC-AVG, highlighting the need for a dedicated benchmark.
blocks.zh: 除了培训数据外,现有基准不足以评估PC-AVG。 如塔布所显示. 2,现行基准 黄等 (2024); 袁等 (2026a); 黄等 (2024). 杨等 (2026b)主要关注一般视频生成能力,包括视觉质量,语义相接,以及时间一致性等. 然而,这些评估框架忽略了特定广告的关键方面,如精细产品保存、销售点可视化和广告有效性等。 这种差距使得很难评价所生成的视频是否不仅能达到高感知质量,而且能遵循预期的广告设计并有效传播商业信息. 因此,现有基准不能充分说明PC-AVG所需的能力,这突出表明需要制定专门的基准。

blocks.en:
To address these limitations, we introduce AdSpark, a large-scale dataset and benchmark for PC-AVG. As shown in Fig. 1 , AdSpark-300K contains 300K high-quality reference image-prompt-video triplets, including 100K real-world and 200K synthetic advertisement videos. It covers 40 diverse product categories, over 3,000 sub-categories, and 651 hours of video. Each sample provides structured annotations for product identity, selling points, creative plans, and aligned audio scripts, enabling faithful product preservation and advertisement-oriented visual storytelling.
Alongside the dataset, we design AdSpark-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark for PC-AVG that evaluates the capabilities of video generation models in advertisement scenarios. Beyond conventional video quality assessment, AdSpark-Bench analyzes whether models can preserve product identity, follow creative plans, present selling points, and generate compelling and commercially effective advertisements.
blocks.zh:
为了克服这些局限性,我们引入了AdSpark,这是PC-AVG的大型数据集和基准. 如图一所示,AdSpark-300K包含有300K高品质的参考图像-即时-视频三重奏,包括100K真实世界和200K合成广告视频. 它涵盖40个不同的产品类别,超过3000个子类别,以及651小时的视频. 每个样本都为产品身份、销售点、创意计划以及对齐的音频脚本提供结构化的说明,从而能够忠实地保存产品和以广告为导向的视觉故事。
除了数据集之外,我们设计了AdSpark-Bench,这是PC-AVG的诊断基准,用来评价广告情景中视频生成模型的能力. 除了传统的视频质量评估外,AdSpark-Bench还分析了模型是否能够保持产品特性,遵循创意计划,呈现出销售点,并生成有说服力和商业效果的广告.

blocks.en: Based on AdSpark-300K, we finetune a reference-to-video generation model HaCohen et al. (2026) and conduct comprehensive evaluations of open-source and proprietary models on AdSpark-Bench. The results validate the effectiveness of AdSpark-300K and provide insights into the capabilities and challenges of current models for PC-AVG. Our main contributions are summarized as follows: • We introduce AdSpark-300K , the first large-scale dataset for PC-AVG, containing 300K high-quality reference image-prompt-video triplets with structured annotations for product identity, selling points, creative plans, and audio scripts. • We propose AdSpark-Bench , a comprehensive and diagnostic benchmark that extends conventional video evaluation with advertisement-specific criteria, including product fidelity, shot compliance, selling-point realization, and advertisement effectiveness. • We conduct comprehensive evaluations on AdSpark-Bench, revealing the limitations of existing models for PC-AVG and demonstrating that fine-tuning a representative video generation model on AdSpark-300K substantially improves advertisement-oriented generation.
blocks.zh: 基于AdSpark-300K,我们微调了参考到视频生成模型HaCohen等 (2026),并在AdSpark-Bench上对开源和专有模型进行全面评价. 结果验证了AdSpark-300K的有效性,并提供了对PC-AVG现有模型的能力和挑战的洞察. 我们的主要贡献概述如下: 我们推出AdSpark-300K,这是PC-AVG的第一个大型数据集,包含300K高品质的参考图像-即时-视频三重机,并有结构化的说明,用于产品身份,销售点,创意计划,以及音频脚本. ^ 我们提出AdSpark-Bench这一全面和诊断性的基准,该基准将常规视频评价与广告特定标准相延伸,包括产品忠实性、镜头合规性、销售点实现性和广告有效性。 我们对AdSpark-Bench进行全面的评价,揭示了PC-AVG现有模型的局限性,并展示了对AdSpark-300K上具有代表性的视频生成模型进行微调大大改善了以广告为导向的生成.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Large-scale video-text datasets, such as WebVid-10M Bain et al. (2021) , Panda-70M Chen et al. (2024) , and InternVid Wang et al. (2023b) , have advanced open-domain video generation. However, they are not curated for advertising scenarios and lack product-specific annotations.
Recent multi-shot video datasets, such as Cine250K Wu et al. (2025) and MuSS Zhang et al. (2026) , further support coherent generation across multiple shots by providing shot-level video structures and cross-shot supervision, but mainly focus on general cinematic or narrative content.
Reference-based video generation datasets, including human-centric Li et al. (2024) ; Hu (2024) and subject-consistent Yuan et al. (2024a) ; Wu et al. (2026) ; Yuan et al. (2026a) datasets, improve subject consistency by preserving referenced subjects but overlook fine-grained product identity and commercial generation requirements. In contrast, AdSpark-300K targets product-centric advertisement video generation with structured annotations covering product identities, selling points, creative plans, and audio scripts.
blocks.zh:
大型视频文本数据集, 如 WebVid- 10M Bain等人(2021年),熊猫-70M 陈等 (2024年),同仁维德·王等 (2023年b) 已先进的开放域视频生成. 然而,它们并不用于广告场景,也没有针对具体产品的说明。
最近的多镜头视频数据集, 如 Cine250K Wu等 (2025)和MuSS Zhang等 (2026),通过提供相片平面视频结构并交叉相片监督,进一步支持多镜头的连贯生成,但主要侧重于一般的电影或叙事内容.
基于参考的视频生成数据集,包括以人为中心的数据集 李等 (2024年); 胡同 (2024年)和主题一致的袁等 (2024年a). Wu等 (2026); Yuan等 (2026a) 数据集,通过保留被引用对象来提高主题的一致性,但忽略了精细的产品特性和商业生成要求. 相形之下,AdSpark-300K针对以产品为中心的广告视频生成,其结构化的说明涵盖产品身份,销售点,创意计划,以及音频脚本.

blocks.en:
Video generation benchmarks have progressed from perceptual quality evaluation to comprehensive assessment of generation capabilities. Representative benchmarks, including VBench Huang et al. (2023) , VBench++ Huang et al. (2024) , EvalCrafter Liu et al. (2024a) , ChronoMagic-Bench Yuan et al. (2024b) , and FETV Liu et al. (2024b) , evaluate videos from multiple perspectives, such as visual quality, semantic alignment, and temporal coherence.
Recent reference-conditioned benchmarks Yuan et al. (2024a) ; Fei et al. (2025) ; Yuan et al. (2026a) further incorporate subject consistency, while multi-shot benchmarks additionally evaluate cross-shot consistency and shot-level controllability Wang et al. (2026b) .
However, these benchmarks mainly target general video generation and overlook advertisement-specific demands such as product fidelity, selling-point realization and advertisement effectiveness. AdSpark-Bench fills this gap by providing a dedicated evaluation framework for PC-AVG.

然而,这些基准主要针对一般的视频生成,忽略了特定广告的需求,如产品忠实,销售点实现和广告效果等. AdSpark-Bench通过为PC-AVG提供专门的评价框架来填补这一空白.

blocks.en: 3 AdSpark-300K
blocks.zh: 3 AdSpark-300K 软件

blocks.en: Figure 2: Overview of the AdSpark-300K construction pipeline, comprising real-world advertisement curation and synthetic advertisement construction, each involving tailored stages for comprehensive and unified annotation.
blocks.zh: 图2:AdSpark-300K建筑管线概况,由现实世界广告典籍和合成广告建筑组成,每条管线都涉及全面统一注释的定制阶段.

blocks.en:
As illustrated in Fig. 2 , AdSpark-300K comprises complementary real-world and synthetic subsets, each developed through a rigorous multi-stage pipeline of filtering, annotation, and quality control. Built upon real-world product assets and associated metadata collected from an e-commerce platform with proper authorization, both subsets share a unified data format containing a reference image, a product-centric advertisement video, and structured annotations.
In this section, we will present the construction of each subset and summarize the overall dataset statistics.
blocks.zh:
如图2所示,AdSpark-300K由互为补充的现实世界和合成子集组成,每个子集通过严格的多阶段过滤、注释和质量控制管道得到发展。 以真实世界的产品资产和相关元数据为基础,经适当授权从电子商务平台收集,两个子集共享一个统一的数据格式,其中包含参考图像、以产品为中心的广告视频和结构化说明。
在本节中,我们将介绍每个子集的构造,并概述总体数据集统计数据。

blocks.en: 3.1 Real-World Advertisement Curation
blocks.zh: 3.1 《真实世界广告指南》

blocks.en:
We collect paired advertisement videos, product reference images, and foreground masks from a major e-commerce platform. Given these paired assets, we first use SAM2 Ravi et al. (2024) to segment and track the target product throughout the video, as show in Fig. 2 (a). We then apply a two-stage filtering procedure to retain reliable product-centric advertisement clips.
In the first stage, frame-level geometric and temporal filtering removes frames where the product is too small, the mask area changes abruptly, the centroid shifts substantially, or the mask touches the image boundary, as these cases indicate poor visibility or unstable tracking.
In the second stage, we group consecutive valid frames into 5–20 second candidate clips and perform VLM-based quality filtering using Qwen3-VL-235B Bai et al. (2025) , guided by the product reference image, to evaluate product identity consistency, product visibility, and overlay artifacts. Clips failing any criterion are discarded.
blocks.zh:
我们从一个大型电子商务平台收集成对的广告视频、产品参考图像和前台口罩。 鉴于这些配对资产,我们首先使用SAM2 Ravi等人(2024年)在整个视频中分出并跟踪目标产品,如图2(a)所示. 然后,我们采用两阶段过滤程序,保留可靠的以产品为中心的广告片段。
在第一阶段,帧平面几何和时间过滤会移除产品太小的帧,遮罩区域会突然变化,百分行星会大幅移动,或遮罩会触碰图像边界,因为这些案例表明能见度差或跟踪不稳定.
在第二阶段,我们将连续有效的帧组合成5至20个第二候选剪辑,并利用Qune3-VL-235B进行基于VLM的质量过滤。 Bai等 (2025) 在产品参考图像的指导下,评价产品识别一致性,产品能见度,并覆盖文物. 任何标准的剪贴被丢弃。

blocks.en:
After obtaining the accepted temporally continuous clips, we use TransNetV2 Soucek and Lokoc (2024) to segment them into shots. Since the original videos lack structured advertisement annotations, Qwen3-VL-235B Bai et al. (2025) is used to automatically annotate product identities, selling points, and creative plans (scene, style, and shot design) from representative frames. Whisper-Large-v3-Turbo Radford et al. (2023) is used to transcribe the audio and align narration text with the detected shots. Finally, human annotators verify the videos and annotations, correcting errors and removing low-quality or unreliable samples.
Only the videos that pass this final manual inspection are included in AdSpark-300K.
blocks.zh:
在获得被接受的时间连续片段后,我们使用TransNetV2 Soucek和Lokoc(2024年)将其分入镜头. 由于原始视频缺乏结构化广告说明,Quen3-VL-235B Bai等人(2025年)用于从具有代表性的框架自动对产品身份进行注释,销售点和创造性计划(场景,风格和镜头设计). Whisper-Large-v3-Turbo Radford等 (2023)用于对音频进行转录,并用被测出镜头来对齐叙述文本. 最后,人类的注释者核实视频和说明,纠正错误并去除质量低或不可靠的样本.
只有通过这次最终人工检查的视频才被列入AdSpark-300K.

blocks.en: 3.2 Synthetic Advertisement Construction
blocks.zh: 3.2 合成广告建筑

blocks.en: Given the scarcity of high-quality real-world advertisement videos, we construct a synthetic subset complementary to the real-world subset to enhance the diversity and coverage of AdSpark-300K. Starting from products with reference images and associated attributes, we curate a high-quality stock-keeping unit (SKU) pool through three-stage quality, suitability, and category filtering. Specifically, we exclude SKUs with low-quality reference images, unsuitable categories, cluttered backgrounds, multiple dominant objects, or severe occlusion to ensure reliable product-centric generation.
blocks.zh: 由于缺少高质量的现实世界广告视频,我们构建了一个合成子集,补充现实世界子集,以提升AdSpark-300K的多样性和覆盖面. 从具有参考图像和相关属性的产品开始,我们通过三阶段质量、适宜性和分类过滤,管理一个高质量的库存保管单位。 具体地说,我们排除了具有低质量参考图像、不适当的类别、杂乱的背景、多重主要物体或严重被隔离的SKU,以确保可靠的以产品为中心的生成。

blocks.en:
For each retained product, we employ GPT-5.5 to generate structured advertisement annotations conditioned on the reference image and product attributes.
The annotations serve as an intermediate representation for video generation, comprising product identity, selling-point descriptions, creative plans covering scene, style, and shot design, and aligned audio scripts.
In particular, selling points are translated into visualizable actions and effects, enabling the generated videos to demonstrate product functions and commercial appeals rather than merely describe them. The shot-level designs further specify temporal organization, camera motion, and shot type for multi-shot generation. To improve annotations reliability, we employ Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview as an independent reviewer in an iterative review-and-refinement process.
Given the reference image and generated annotations, it evaluates whether the annotations accurately describe the product identity and visual details, align with the selling points, and specify coherent shot designs.
Annotations that fail these criteria are revised by GPT-5.5 according to the reviewer feedback.
blocks.zh:
对于每个被保留的产品,我们使用GPT-5.5生成以参考图像和产品属性为条件的结构化广告说明.
说明作为视频生成的中间代表,包括产品身份、销售点描述、涵盖场景、风格和镜头设计的创造性计划以及对齐的音频脚本。
特别是,销售点被转化为可视的行动和效果,使制作的视频能够显示产品功能和商业吸引力,而不仅仅是描述它们。 镜头平面设计进一步明确了时间组织,相机运动,以及多镜头生成的镜头类型. 为了提高说明的可靠性,我们利用双子座-3.1-Pro-Preview在迭代审查和精炼过程中作为独立的审查者.
考虑到参考图像和生成的说明,它评价说明是否准确描述了产品特性和视觉细节,与销售点一致,并指定了连贯的镜头设计.
不符合这些标准的说明由GPT-5.5根据审查者的反馈修订.

blocks.en: The structured annotations are used to synthesize advertisement videos with multiple state-of-the-art models, including Seedance 2.0 Seedance et al. (2026) , Happy Horse, and Kling Team et al. (2025) , improving generation diversity and reducing model-specific bias. We further conduct human inspection to assess overall video quality, including product fidelity, visual plausibility, motion quality, selling-point realization, and audio alignment, discarding videos with identity drift, severe artifacts, ineffective selling-point presentation, or audio-visual mismatch.
blocks.zh: 结构化说明用于合成具有多款最先进模型的广告视频,包括"种子2.0""种子"等 (2026)"快乐之马""克林团队"等 (2025)",提高生成多样性并减少模型特异性偏差". 我们进一步进行人文检查,评估整体视频质量,包括产品诚实性、视觉可信度、运动质量、销售点实现性、音频对接、丢弃带有身份漂移的视频、严重文物、销售点展示无效或视听不匹配。

blocks.en:
After both construction pipelines, all samples share the same representation. Each sample contains a product reference image, an advertisement video, and structured advertisement annotations comprising product identity, selling-point descriptions, creative plans covering scene, style, and shot design, and aligned audio scripts.
This unified annotation format enables AdSpark-300K to support diverse tasks, from reference-to-video and identity-preserving video generation to PC-AVG.
Examples of the structured annotations are provided in Sup. A .
blocks.zh:
在两条建造管线之后,所有样品都具有相同的代表性。 每个样本包含产品参考图像、广告视频和结构化广告说明,包括产品身份、销售点描述、涵盖场景的创造性计划、风格和镜头设计以及对齐的音频脚本。
这种统一的注释格式使得AdSpark-300K能够支持各种任务,从参考到视频和身份保存视频生成到PC-AVG.
结构说明的例子见Sup.A.。

blocks.en: 4 AdSpark-Bench
blocks.zh: 4 阿德斯帕克-奔驰

blocks.en:
AdSpark-Bench is a comprehensive and diagnostic benchmark designed to evaluate video generation models for PC-AVG. It consists of a carefully curated held-out test set and a hierarchical evaluation framework tailored to the requirements of product-centric advertisements. Specifically, AdSpark-Bench evaluates generated advertisements across six complementary dimensions: visual quality, product fidelity, instruction adherence, temporal coherence, audio alignment, and advertisement effectiveness.
In this section, we first introduce the benchmark statistics and then present the hierarchical evaluation metrics.
blocks.zh:
AdSpark-Bench是一个全面的诊断基准,旨在评价PC-AVG的视频生成模型. 它包括一套精心设计的搁置测试和一套符合以产品为中心的广告要求的分级评价框架。 具体来说,AdSpark-Bench在六个相辅相成的方面评价了生成的广告:视觉质量、产品忠诚度、遵守指令、时间一致性、音频一致性和广告有效性。
在本节中,我们首先介绍基准统计,然后介绍等级评价衡量标准。

blocks.en: 4.1 Benchmark Statistics
blocks.zh: 4.1 基准统计

blocks.en:
AdSpark-Bench contains 220 product-conditioned test cases covering all 40 product categories and 220 distinct sub-categories. All benchmark samples are SKU-disjoint from the AdSpark-300K training set. Each case consists of a product reference image and structured advertisement annotations specifying product identity, selling points, creative plans covering scene, style, and shot design, and aligned audio scripts.
AdSpark-Bench is carefully curated to support advertisement-specific and shot-aware evaluation.
It contains 45 one-shot, 131 two-shot, and 44 three-shot cases, yielding 175 multi-shot cases for evaluating cross-shot product consistency, transition quality, and narrative coherence.
All cases are manually reviewed to ensure reference quality, annotation completeness, and generation suitability.
blocks.zh:
AdSpark-Bench包含220个产品条件测试案例,涵盖所有40个产品类别和220个不同的子类别. 所有基准样本都是AdSpark-300K训练集的SKU-分集. 每个案例由产品参考图像和结构化的广告说明组成,说明产品身份,销售点,涵盖场景的创意计划,风格,和镜头设计,以及对齐的音频脚本.
AdSpark-Bench被精心地整理,以支持广告的特异性和射入意识的评价.
它包含45个一发、131个两发和44个三发案例,产生了175个多发案例,用于评价交叉一发产品的一致性、过渡质量和叙述一致性。
所有案例都经过人工审查,以确保参考质量、注释的完整性和生成是否合适。

blocks.en: 4.2 Hierarchical Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 4.2 等级评价计量

blocks.en: AdSpark-Bench evaluates generated advertisements across six dimensions, each comprising multiple diagnostic submetrics. We next describe the evaluation methodology for these dimensions and submetrics. More detailed metric definitions and implementation procedures are provided in Sup. B .
blocks.zh: AdSpark-Bench评价生成的广告涉及6个维度,每个维度都包含多个诊断分计量. 我们接下来将介绍对这些层面和次计量的评价方法。 Sup.B.提供了更详细的计量定义和执行程序。

blocks.en:
Direct evaluation of multi-shot videos may confuse intentional transitions with temporal artifacts and obscure shot-level generation quality. We therefore use TransNetV2 Soucek and Lokoc (2024) to segment each video into ordered shots and greedily match them to the planned shots by temporal IoU.
The resulting shot correspondences are shared across shot-structure, shot-execution, and cross-shot consistency evaluations, enabling reliable assessment of both intra-shot quality and inter-shot transitions.
blocks.zh:
对多镜头视频的直接评价可能会将有意过渡与时空文物相混淆,并模糊出镜头级生成质量. 因此,我们使用TransNetV2 Soucek和Lokoc(2024年)将每段视频分入订购镜头,并贪婪地用时间IoU将其与计划镜头相匹配.
由此产生的相机通信在相机结构、相机执行和相机一致性评价之间共享,从而能够可靠地评估相机内质量和相机间过渡。

blocks.en: We follow OpenS2V Yuan et al. (2026a) and adopt Aesthetic Score to assess visual appeal and MUSIQ Ke et al. (2021) to evaluate perceptual image quality.
blocks.zh: 我们跟着OpenS2V 袁等 (2026a)并采用"美学分数"来评估视觉吸引力并采用"MUSIQ Ke等 (2021)"来评价视觉图像质量.

blocks.en: Conventional subject-consistency metrics compare complete frames with reference images, making them sensitive to background variations and inadequate for fine-grained product identity evaluation. To address this limitation, we use GroundingDINO Liu et al. (2023) and SAM2 Ravi et al. (2024) to extract foreground regions at different granularities, including full products, key identity regions and packaging text. Based on these regions, we design four complementary metrics: (1) Subject Consistency measures cosine similarity between DINOv3 Siméoni et al. (2025) features of full-product crops from video frames and the reference image, evaluating overall product appearance preservation. (2) Key-Region Similarity evaluates identity-defining regions that may be overlooked by holistic features, including logos, brand marks, and packaging detail. Annotated region descriptions are used to localize corresponding regions in reference and generated frames, which are then compared using DINOv3 features. (3) Text Fidelity evaluates whether annotated product-related text, such as brand names and packaging text, remains recognizable in generated videos. RapidOCR is applied to localized product crops, and each target string is matched with recognized text using minimum edit distance. (4) Cross-shot Product Consistency measures product identity stability across shot transitions by computing DINOv3 feature similarity between full-product crops before and after each cut, capturing abrupt identity changes overlooked by whole-video averaging.
blocks.zh: 常规主题一致性测量标准将完整的帧与参考图像相比较,使其对背景变化敏感,不足以进行精细产品识别评价. 为了解决这一限制,我们利用地平地DINO Liu等人(2023年)和SAM2 Ravi等人(2024年)在不同颗粒地提取前景区域,包括完整的产品、关键身份区域和包装文本。 基于这些区域,我们设计了四个相辅相成的衡量标准: (1)主题一致性计量 DINOv3 Siméoni等人(2025年)从视频帧得到的全产品作物特征与参考图像相近,评价产品外观的整体保存情况. (2)关键区域相似性评价身份界定区域,这些区域可能被整体特征所忽略,包括标志,品牌标识和包装细节等. 附加说明的区域描述用于在参考和生成的框中将相应的区域本地化,然后使用DINOv3特性来比较. (3)文本Fieldity评价在生成的视频中是否仍然能识别品牌和包装文本等与产品相关的注释文本. RapidOCR被应用于本地化的产品收成上,每个目标字符串都使用最小编辑距离与被认可的文本相匹配. (4) 跨镜头产品一致性通过计算DINOv3来测量产品在瞬间过渡中的特性稳定性,在每次切开前后都具有完全产品作物之间的相似性,捕捉到被全视平分忽略的突然特性变化.

blocks.en:
Existing video-text alignment metrics mainly measure global semantic correspondence, overlooking planned shot structure, camera design, and selling-point realization.
We therefore evaluate instruction adherence using three fine-grained shot-aware dimensions, complemented by a global video–text alignment metric: (1) Shot Structure Alignment assesses whether the generated shot sequence follows the planned structure. It measures shot-count accuracy by comparing detected and planned shot numbers, while boundary accuracy evaluates whether planned shot transitions are detected within a temporal tolerance. (2) Shot Execution Alignment evaluates the consistency of each matched shot with its prescribed shot type and motion design. For each matched shot, GPT-5.5 takes sampled video frames and optical-flow-based motion cues as input to assess alignment between the generated camera behavior and the planned design. (3) Content Alignment focuses on whether generated videos realize the advertisement plan, including scene, style, and selling-point realization. For scene and style alignment, GPT-5.5 assesses representative frames with corresponding annotations.
For selling-point realization, we use denser shot-aware sampling to better capture short functional demonstrations or interaction actions, and evaluate them against the expected visual realizations and success criteria.
We additionally report (4) GmeScore , computed with gme-Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct Zhang et al. (2024) , to measure global alignment between the complete advertisement prompt and sampled video frames.
blocks.zh:
现有的视频文本校正度量度主要衡量全球语义对应,俯瞰计划中的镜头结构,相机设计,以及销售点实现.
因此,我们利用三个精细的射入感知维度评价遵守指令的情况,并辅之以全球视频文本校正度量度: (1)相机结构对接评估所生成相机序列是否遵循所规划的结构. 它通过比较测出和计划测出的射出数来测量射出数的精度,而边界精确度则评价计划中的射出数过渡是否在时间耐受性范围内被测出. (2) 射击射击对接评估每一次射击与其规定的射击类型和运动设计的一致性。 对于每个相匹配镜头,GPT-5.5取取取被取样的视频帧和光学流动提示作为输入,以评估所生成相机行为与所计划设计之间的相接一致. (3)内容对接关注生成的视频是否实现了广告计划,包括场景,风格,以及销售点实现等. 对于场景和风格相配,GPT-5.5评估具有代表性的框并有相应的说明.
对于卖点实现,我们使用更密集的射入意识取样来更好地捕捉短期的功能演示或互动动作,并对照预期的视觉实现和成功标准来评价它们.
我们又报告(4) GmeScore用gme-Qune2-VL-7B-Instruct Zhang等人(2024年)计算,以衡量完整广告即时和抽样录像帧之间的全球一致。

blocks.en:
Standard temporal metrics mainly focus on generic frame-level consistency and may overlook product-specific instability or misinterpret intentional shot transitions as temporal artifacts. To better capture these factors, we evaluate temporal coherence from three perspectives: intra-shot motion quality, transition naturalness, and temporal consistency. (1) Intra-shot Motion Quality evaluates motion dynamics within each shot. We include Motion Amplitude following OpenS2V Yuan et al. (2026a) and measure Motion Smoothness using the coefficient of variation (CV) of frame-wise motion magnitudes derived from optical flow. To account for product-centric generation, we use GroundingDINO and SAM2 to track the advertised product and measure Product Motion Stability based on mask-centroid displacement, mask-area variation, and adjacent-mask IoU. (2) Transition Naturalness measures whether detected cuts form visually plausible transitions without abrupt visual artifacts.
We first apply a pixel-level validity check to identify corrupted frames, and then use GPT-5.5 to assess transition naturalness in terms of brightness, style continuity, and artifact absence. (3) Temporal Consistency evaluates local temporal stability around shot boundaries. For each detected boundary, we inspect duplicated, flickering, or structurally corrupted frames using adjacent-frame differences and SSIM Nilsson and Akenine-Möller (2020) .
blocks.zh:
标准的时间衡量标准主要侧重于通用框架层面的一致性,可能忽略特定产品的不稳定性,或将有意的瞬间过渡误解为时间文物。 为了更好地抓住这些因素,我们从三个角度评价时间一致性:内射运动质量、过渡自然性和时间一致性。 (1)内射运动质量评价每个镜头内的运动动态. 包括OpenS2V之后的振幅 Yuan等 (2026a)并使用从光学流得到的帧相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 为了对以产品为中心的一代进行统计,我们利用GroundingDINO和SAM2来跟踪所公布的产品,并根据面具-中心机器人的置换、面具-区域变异以及相邻的面具IoU来衡量产品运动稳定性。 ( 二 ) 自然 性 度 测量 所 测出 的 切 是否 在 不 有 突然 的 视觉 文物 下 形成 貌似 的 过渡 。
我们首先采用像素级有效性检查来识别被破坏的相框,然后使用GPT-5.5来从亮度,风格连续性,以及文物缺失等方面来评估过渡自然性. (3) 时间一致性评价在镜头边界周围的局部时间稳定性。 使用相邻的框和SSIM Nilsson和Akenine-Möller(2020年),

blocks.en: For videos containing a valid non-silent audio stream, we evaluate audio alignment from two aspects. (1) Background Sound Consistency uses LAION-CLAP Wu et al. (2023) to measure the semantic similarity between the generated audio and the expected background sound description specified in the creative plan. (2) Narration Script Consistency uses Whisper-Large-v3-Turbo Radford et al. (2023) to transcribe the generated narration and compares the recognized text with the reference audio script using character error rate (CER), measuring whether the intended commercial message is faithfully conveyed.
blocks.zh: 对于包含有效的非静音音频流的视频,我们从两个方面评价音频对齐. (1)背景声音一致性使用LAION-CLAP Wu等 (2023),以测量生成的音频与创作计划中所指定的预期背景声音描述之间的语义相似. (2) 叙述脚本一致性使用Whisper-Large-v3-Turbo Radford等 (2023) 将生成的解说进行转录,并使用字符错误率(CER)来将所识别的文字与参考音频脚本进行比较,以衡量预期的商业消息是否忠实地传递.

blocks.en: A visually coherent video may still fail as an advertisement if it lacks viewer appeal, commercial persuasiveness, or coherent storytelling. We therefore employ GPT-5.5 to serve as a potential customer to assess advertisement effectiveness across three aspects. (1) Advertisement Attractiveness evaluates whether the generated advertisement can capture viewer attention and stimulate purchase interest from a customer perspective, considering visual appeal, product desirability, and overall viewing experience. (2) Creative Quality evaluates the artistic and commercial quality of generated advertisements, including visual impact, commercial readiness, and product-oriented creativity. (3) Narrative Coherence evaluates whether multi-shot advertisements achieve coherent storytelling rather than disconnected scenes, considering shot-to-shot consistency, selling-point progression, narrative logic, and pacing.

blocks.en:
We report quantitative comparisons on AdSpark-Bench in Tab. 3 . Existing video generation models achieve competitive performance in visual quality, but fall short in some advertisement-specific capabilities. We summarize three main observations from the results.
(1) Closed-source models generally outperform open-source models, yet still face some notable challenges. For example, although they can generate more dynamic and visually engaging videos, preserving product fidelity during complex motions remains a prominent issue, with motion blur, shape distortion, and appearance drift degrading subject consistency, key-region similarity and text fidelity.
(2) Open-source models exhibit more pronounced limitations in instruction adherence and advertisement effectiveness, and often struggle with coherent multi-shot generation, as reflected by weaker cross-shot product consistency and temporal coherence.
(3) Fine-tuning with AdSpark-300K substantially improves PC-AVG performance. Compared with the base LTX-2 model, LTX-AdSpark improves cross-shot product consistency from 33.30 to 93.59, shot structure alignment from 46.29 to 77.53, and narrative coherence from 33.77 to 89.89, demonstrating the utility of AdSpark-300K for PC-AVG.
We further analyze the effects of real-world and synthetic data composition and training scale through controlled ablations in Tab. 6 .

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We introduce AdSpark, a large-scale dataset and benchmark for product-centric advertisement video generation. AdSpark-300K provides 300K reference image–prompt–video triplets with structured annotations, while AdSpark-Bench evaluates six dimensions: visual quality, product fidelity, instruction adherence, temporal coherence, audio alignment, and advertisement effectiveness. Experiments show that existing models struggle with product-specific generation, while AdSpark-300K fine-tuning improves advertisement capabilities. We hope AdSpark will facilitate future research on controllable and high-quality PC-AVG.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了AdSpark,这是一个以产品为中心的广告视频生成的大规模数据集和基准. AdSpark-300K提供300K的参考图像-即时-视频三重奏有结构化的说明;而AdSpark-Bench则评价了六个维度:视觉质量,产品忠心,指令遵守,时间一致性,音频对接,以及广告有效性. 实验显示,现有模型与产品特异性生成相抗争,而AdSpark-300K微调则能提高广告能力. 我们希望AdSpark将促进未来对可控制和高质量PC-AVG的研究.

blocks.en: Appendix A Additional Details of AdSpark-300K
blocks.zh: 附录A 阿德斯帕克-300K的附加细节

blocks.en: A.1 Data Sources and Collection Protocol
blocks.zh: A.1 数据来源和收集协议

blocks.en:
All data in AdSpark-300K were obtained from the product detail pages of a major e-commerce platform through authorized internal interfaces, without using external public datasets. Based on platform-wide click-through statistics on April 15, 2026, we selected approximately 600K top-ranked SKUs and retrieved all available product assets and metadata associated with them. The retrieved data may include merchant-uploaded transparent-background product images, advertisement videos with audio, SKU identifiers, product titles, brands, category labels, attributes, and selling-point descriptions. Foreground masks were derived from the alpha channels of valid transparent-background reference images. Since not every SKU is associated with all asset types, we construct the real-world and synthetic subsets using different eligibility criteria.
For the real-world subset, we retain SKUs with valid associations among an advertisement video, a transparent-background product reference image, and the corresponding product metadata. Each SKU may be associated with multiple videos, and each video may be further segmented into multiple clips. For the synthetic subset, we retain SKUs with valid reference images and product metadata, regardless of whether a paired advertisement video is available. We remove samples with invalid SKU associations, missing required assets, corrupted files, incomplete metadata, duplicate content, unsupported formats, unsuitable video durations, or sensitive product categories. The real-world and synthetic subsets may share SKUs, while AdSpark-Bench is strictly SKU-disjoint from AdSpark-300K.
blocks.zh:
AdSpark-300K的所有数据都是通过授权的内部接口从一个大型电子商务平台的产品细节页上获取的,没有使用外部公共数据集. 根据2026年4月15日全平台的点击数据,我们选择了大约600K名列前茅的SKU,并检索了与之相关的所有现有产品资产和元数据. 检索出的数据可能包括商家上载的透明背景产品图像、带有音频的广告视频、SKU标识、产品标题、品牌、类别标签、属性和销售点描述。 前景口罩来源于有效的透明背景参考图像的α通道. 由于并非所有SKU都与所有资产类型相关联,我们采用不同的资格标准构建现实世界和合成子集.
对于现实世界的子集,我们保留了SKU,在广告视频,透明背景产品参考图像,以及相应的产品元数据中具有有效的关联. 每个SKU可能与多个视频相关联,每个视频可能被进一步分解成多个片段. 对于合成子集,我们保留具有有效参考图像和产品元数据的SKU,不管是否有配对的广告视频. 我们删除带有无效的 SKU 关联的样本, 缺少所需的资产, 损坏的文件, 不完整的元数据, 重复的内容, 不支持的格式, 不合适的视频持续时间, 或者敏感的产品类别 。 现实世界和合成子集可能共享SKU,而AdSpark-Bench则严格来说是AdSpark-300K的SKU-分解.

blocks.en: A.2 Real-World Advertisement Curation
blocks.zh: A.2 真实世界广告说明

blocks.en: We first identify candidate SKUs with valid product reference images, associated metadata, and at least one advertisement video. Starting from approximately 600K click-ranked SKUs, we filter the associated videos according to their duration and frame rate. Specifically, we retain videos with durations between 10 and 1,000 seconds and frame rates of 24 or 25 fps. This filtering results in 192,077 SKUs with at least one eligible advertisement video, comprising 218,837 video entries in total. Among them, 26,760 SKUs are associated with multiple eligible videos. Each retained SKU–video pair is then processed independently by the subsequent product-tracking and clip-level filtering pipeline.
blocks.zh: 我们首先确定候选 SKUs 有有效的产品参考图像, 相关的元数据, 以及至少一个广告视频。 从大约600K点击排序的SKU开始,我们根据相关视频的持续时间和帧率过滤. 具体来说,我们保留了持续时间在10至1000秒之间的视频,帧率为24至25英尺. 过滤结果为192,077个SKU,其中至少有1个符合资格的广告视频,共包含218,837个视频条目. 其中26,760 SKU与多个符合条件的视频相关. 每个保留了SKU-video配对,然后由后续的产品跟踪和剪接层过滤管独立处理.

blocks.en: For each SKU-associated advertisement video, we initialize product tracking using the foreground mask derived from the alpha channel of its transparent-background reference image. We employ SAM2.1-Hiera-Large Ravi et al. (2024) to propagate the product mask throughout the video and apply frame-level geometric and temporal filtering. Specifically, frames are rejected when the product bounding-box or mask area occupies less than 5% of the frame, the mask area exceeds 80%, or the mask approaches the frame boundary within a margin of 2%. We further discard unstable tracking results when the mask-area ratio between adjacent frames exceeds 3.0 or the normalized centroid displacement exceeds 0.35. Consecutive valid frames are grouped into candidate clips of 5–20 seconds. Longer intervals are divided into non-overlapping clips of at most 20 seconds, while intervals and residual segments shorter than 5 seconds are discarded.
blocks.zh: 对于每个SKU相关广告视频,我们使用其透明-背景参考图像的α通道所衍生的前缘口罩来初始化产品跟踪. 我们利用SAM2.1-Hiera-Large Ravi等人(2024年)在整个视频中传播产品口罩,并应用帧级几何和时间过滤. 具体地说,当产品边框或口罩面积占帧面积不到5%,口罩面积超过80%,或者口罩接近帧边界的相差为2%时,会拒绝帧. 如果相邻帧之间的遮罩-面积比超过3.0,或正常的百分数迁移超过0.35,我们进一步丢弃不稳定的跟踪结果. 连续有效的帧被分组为5至20秒的候选剪辑. 更长的间隔被分为不超过20秒的非重叠片段,而间隔和短于5秒的剩余片段被丢弃.

blocks.en: We further evaluate each candidate clip using Qwen3-VL-235B Bai et al. (2025) , conditioned on the product reference image and up to 10 representative frames sampled from the clip. The model examines whether the advertised product remains consistent with the reference image, is sufficiently visible and complete, and is free from severe occlusion or tracking errors. It also identifies intrusive overlay artifacts, such as large floating text or graphics that obscure the product, while excluding text originally printed on the product or packaging from this criterion. A candidate clip is rejected if any sampled frame exhibits substantial product identity drift, poor visibility, severe obstruction, or prominent overlay artifacts. The complete prompt template is provided in Fig. 12
blocks.zh: 我们使用Qune3-VL-235B进一步评价每个候选剪辑 Bai等 (英语). 2025),以产品参考图像为条件,从剪辑中取出最多10个代表性帧样本. 该模型审查所公布的产品是否与参考图像一致,是否足够可见和完整,是否没有严重隐入或跟踪错误。 它还查明了侵扰性上覆文物,如能遮蔽出产品的大型浮出文字或图形,同时将原先印在产品上或包装上的文字排除在这一标准之外. 如果取样的相框显示产品识别漂移程度高、能见度低、有严重障碍或有突出的上层文物,则将拒绝选取剪辑。 完整的即时模板由Fig提供. 第12条

blocks.en:
Accepted clips are segmented into ordered shots using TransNetV2 Soucek and Lokoc (2024) . Representative frames from each shot, together with the reference image and associated product metadata, are then provided to Qwen3-VL-235B Bai et al. (2025) to generate structured annotations, including product identity, selling points, and creative plans covering scene, style, and shot design. The prompt template is provided in Fig. 13 .
Whisper-Large-v3-Turbo Radford et al. (2023) is used to transcribe the original audio, and timestamped narration is aligned with the corresponding shots.
Finally, a team of 20 trained annotators with experience in e-commerce product content and advertisement video inspection manually verifies both the videos and their annotations.
The videos are distributed across the annotator pool, with each sample independently reviewed by one annotator under a unified inspection guideline.
They correct inaccurate product descriptions, shot boundaries, and transcription errors, and remove samples with unreliable annotations, product inconsistency, or insufficient overall quality. Only clips that pass this final verification are retained in the real-world subset of AdSpark-300K.

使用TransNetV2 Soucek和Lokoc(2024年), 然后向Qune3-VL-235B提供来自每一镜头的代表性框架以及参考图像和相关产品元数据 Bai 等 (2025) 生成结构化的说明,包括产品身份,销售点,以及涵盖场景,风格,镜头设计的创造性计划. 图13提供了即时模板。
低语-长发-v3-turbo Radford等 (2023年)用于转录原声带,并被打出时间戳的叙述与相应的镜头对齐.
最后,一个由20名在电子商务产品内容和广告录像检查方面有经验的专家组成的小组对录像及其说明进行了人工核查。
视频在注释库中分发,每个样本由一名注释员根据统一的检查准则独立审查。
他们纠正了产品描述不准确,射出界限,以及抄录错误,并删除了说明不可靠,产品不一致,或整体质量不足的样本. 只有通过这个最终验证的片段才被保留在AdSpark-300K的现实世界子集中.

blocks.en: A.3 Synthetic Advertisement Construction
blocks.zh: A.3 合成广告建筑

blocks.en: We construct the synthetic subset through four stages: SKU selection, structured advertisement planning, iterative annotation review, and multi-model video generation followed by manual quality inspection.
blocks.zh: 我们通过四个阶段构建合成子集:SKU选择,结构化的广告规划,迭代注释审查,以及多模型视频生成,然后进行人工质量检查.

blocks.en: We begin with 600,000 click-ranked candidate SKUs collected from the e-commerce platform and construct the synthetic SKU pool through three stages of filtering.
blocks.zh: 我们从从电子商务平台收集的60万个按点击排名的候选SKU开始,通过三个过滤阶段构建合成SKU池.

blocks.en: First, quality filtering verifies the availability and basic quality of the product assets. We retain only SKUs with valid product metadata and a transparent-background reference image. The reference image is further required to have a resolution of at least 800 × 800 800\times 800 , a valid transparency channel, and a supported image format. We also remove corrupted files, incomplete metadata, duplicate content, and categories that are unsuitable for advertisement video generation. This stage removes 199,870 SKUs and retains 400,130 quality-qualified candidates.
blocks.zh: 一,质量过滤 核实产品资产的可用性和基本质量. 我们只保留具有有效产品元数据和透明背景参考图像的SKU. 参考图像还需要有至少800×800800\times 800的分辨率,有效的透明通道,以及支持的图像格式. 我们也删除被损坏的文件,不完整的元数据,重复的内容,以及不适合广告视频生成的类别. 这一阶段取消了199,870个SKU,并保留了400,130个合格的候选人。

blocks.en: Second, suitability filtering evaluates whether the retained reference images are appropriate for product-centric advertisement video generation. We employ Qwen3-VL-235B to analyze each transparent-background product image and produce structured annotations covering generation suitability, the number of independently sellable primary subjects, the number of visible items, and potential visual contamination. We retain only images assigned a high generation-suitability level, containing no more than four primary subjects and four visible items, and exhibiting no promotional overlays, non-product text, watermarks, human presence, or residual scene elements. This stage removes 49,290 SKUs and retains 350,840 generation-suitable candidates.
blocks.zh: 第二,适当性过滤评估所保留的参考图像是否适合以产品为中心的广告视频生成。 我们使用Qune3-VL-235B来分析每个透明背景产品图像,并制作结构化的说明,涵盖生成合适性、可独立出售的主体数量、可见物品数量和可能的视觉污染。 我们只保留了高度适合生成的图像,其中包含不超过4个主题和4个醒目物品,并且没有显示任何宣传花纹、非产品文字、水印、人类存在或残余场景元素。 这一阶段取消了49,290个SKU,并保留了350,840个适合一代的候选者.

blocks.en: Third, category filtering removes SKUs from product categories unsuitable for product-centric advertisement video generation. We read the category and sub-category labels from the associated product metadata and apply a predefined category exclusion list. At the category level, we exclude non-physical products, service-oriented items, sensitive medical and healthcare products, second-hand goods, digital content, and other categories with substantial advertising-compliance or generation risks. We further remove unsuitable sub-categories that remain within otherwise valid primary categories, such as virtual products, rental and installation services, prescription-related products, examination materials, and collectible or investment-oriented items. SKUs with missing, corrupted, or unreadable category metadata are also discarded. This stage removes 2,314 SKUs and retains 348,526 category-compliant candidates.
blocks.zh: 第三,分类过滤将SKU从产品类别中去除,不适合以产品为中心的广告视频生成. 我们从相关产品元数据中读取了类别和子类别标签,并应用了预先定义的类别排除列表. 在类别一级,我们排除了非物质产品、面向服务的物品、敏感的医疗和保健产品、二手货物、数字内容以及具有重大广告合规或生成风险的其他类别。 我们进一步去除留在其他有效初级类别内的不适当的子类别,如虚拟产品、租赁和安装服务、处方相关产品、考试材料以及可收集或面向投资的项目。 缺少,被损坏或无法读取的分类元数据 SKU也被丢弃. 这一阶段取消了2,314个SKU,并保留了348,526个符合类别要求的候选人。

blocks.en: Following the three-stage filtering, 348,526 candidate SKUs remain. We rank these candidates according to platform-wide click statistics and sequentially process them in descending order. Each candidate SKU is used to generate at most one synthetic advertisement. Samples rejected during subsequent advertisement-plan review or manual inspection are discarded, and the next ranked candidates are processed until 200K quality-controlled synthetic advertisements are collected.
blocks.zh: 在三阶段过滤后,仍有348 526名候选SKU。 我们根据全平台点击统计数据对这些候选人进行排序,并依次依次对其进行处理。 每个候选的SKU最多用来制作一款合成广告. 在随后的广告计划审查或人工检查中被拒绝的样本被丢弃,接下来的排名候选者会被处理,直到收集出200K质量控制的合成广告.

blocks.en: Table 4: Statistics of the three-stage SKU filtering pipeline. The number of removed SKUs is computed relative to the preceding stage.
blocks.zh: 表4:三相SKU滤管统计. 被移除的SKU数是相对于前一阶段计算的.

blocks.en:
For each selected SKU, we employ GPT-5.5 to jointly generate structured advertisement annotations and the corresponding visual and audio instructions, conditioned on the product reference and associated metadata. Consistent with the unified representation introduced in the main paper, the annotations comprise product identity, selling-point descriptions, creative plans covering scene, style, and shot design, and aligned audio scripts. Merchant-provided selling-point descriptions serve as the primary basis for advertisement planning. GPT-5.5 translates these selling points into explicit visual realizations and observable success criteria, enabling them to be demonstrated through the generated content rather than merely described in narration.
The creative plan contains one to five temporally ordered shots, each specifying its time interval, shot type, camera motion, and corresponding selling points. The shot intervals are non-overlapping and jointly cover the complete video duration. The output further includes executable shot-by-shot visual instructions and shot-aligned audio-generation instructions. GPT-5.5 is explicitly instructed to avoid introducing unsupported functions, numerical claims, or product properties. The condensed prompt used for structured annotation and visual–audio instruction generation is provided in Fig. 15 .
blocks.zh:
对于每个选定的SKU,我们使用GPT-5.5联合生成结构化的广告说明和相应的视觉和音频指令,并以产品参考和相关元数据为条件. 与正文中引入的统一表述一致,说明由产品身份,销售点描述,覆盖场景的创意计划,风格,镜头设计,以及相通的音频脚本组成. 销售点说明是广告规划的主要依据。 GPT-5.5将这些销售点转化为明确的视觉实现和可观察到的成功标准,使得它们能够通过生成的内容进行演示,而不仅仅是在叙述中被描述.
创意计划包含一至五个按时间顺序订购的镜头,每个镜头指定其时间间隔,镜头类型,相机运动,以及相应的销售点. 拍摄间隔不相重叠,共同覆盖整个视频持续时间. 输出进一步包括可执行的逐发可视指令和相接相接音频生成指令. 明确指示GPT-5.5避免引入不支持的函数,数字索赔,或产品属性. 图15提供了用于结构化注解和视觉-音频教学生成的收缩提示。

blocks.en:
Figure 5: Additional statistics of AdSpark-300K. The figure summarizes the distributions of (a) shot-level camera motions, (b) shot types, (c) the number of selling points per product, and (d) advertisement prompt lengths, illustrating the diversity of camera design, product presentation, commercial content, and prompt complexity
in the dataset.
blocks.zh:
图5:AdSpark-300K的补充统计. 该图汇总了(a) 相机平相机运动、(b) 相机类型、(c) 每种产品销售点数和(d) 广告快取长度的分布情况,说明了相机设计、产品展示、商业内容和迅速复杂程度的多样性
在数据集中。

blocks.en:
To improve annotation accuracy and generation feasibility, we employ Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview as an independent reviewer. Given the product images, metadata, and generated advertisement annotations, the reviewer examines product identity accuracy, selling-point validity, consistency between selling points and their visual realizations, shot-structure coherence, physical plausibility, and visual–audio alignment.
If the annotations are rejected, GPT-5.5 revises them according to the reviewer feedback. We perform at most five review-and-refinement rounds. The annotations are accepted immediately once they pass the reviewer; otherwise, the corresponding SKU is discarded after the fifth unsuccessful round. This process removes samples containing incorrect product descriptions, unsupported selling points, contradictory shot designs, physically implausible interactions, or mismatched visual and audio instructions. The condensed reviewer prompt used in this process is provided in Fig. 17 .
blocks.zh:
为了提高注释的准确性和生成可行性,我们利用双子座3.1-Pro-Preview作为独立的审查者. 考虑到产品图像、元数据以及广告说明,审查者将审查产品身份的准确性、销售点的有效性、销售点与其视觉实现的一致性、镜头结构的一致性、物理可信度和视觉-音频对接。
如果说明被否决,GPT-5.5根据审查者的反馈加以修订. 我们最多进行五轮审查并进行精炼。 说明通过审查者后立即被接受;否则,相应的SKU在第五轮失败后被丢弃. 这个过程去除了包含不正确的产品描述,不支持的销售点,自相矛盾的镜头设计,物理上不可信的相互作用,或者不匹配的视觉和音频指令等样本. 图17提供了在此过程中使用的压缩审查器提示。

blocks.en:
The accepted structured plans are used to synthesize product-centric advertisement videos. Seedance 2.0 serves as the primary generator and accounts for the majority of the synthetic subset. We additionally include HappyHorse and Kling to increase visual diversity and reduce dependence on the generation characteristics of a single model.
All models receive the product reference image and the corresponding advertisement instructions. Videos are generated in a vertical 9 : 16 9{:}16 format at 720p resolution, with durations ranging from 5 to 15 seconds. Audio generation is enabled to synthesize narration, background sound, and action-related sound effects according to the aligned audio plan. The generation instructions prohibit subtitles, promotional overlays, watermarks, interface elements, and other non-product text.
blocks.zh:
公认的结构化计划被用来合成以产品为中心的广告视频. 种子2.0是主要生成器,占合成子集的大部分. 我们还包括了HappyHorse和克林来增加视觉多样性并减少对单一模型的生成特性的依赖.
所有模型都收到产品参考图像和相应的广告说明. 视频以垂直9:16 9{:}16格式以720p分辨率生成,持续时间从5到15秒. 音频生成能够按照对齐的音频计划合成解说,背景声音,以及与动作相关的声音效果. 生成指令禁止字幕,促销覆盖,水印,界面元素等非产品文本.

blocks.en:
Each generated advertisement is reviewed by one trained annotator from the team described in Sup. A.2 , following a sample-level accept-or-reject protocol.
The inspection covers five aspects: product fidelity, visual plausibility, motion and temporal quality, selling-point realization, and audio quality and alignment.
blocks.zh:
每出广告都由来自Sup.A.2所述团队的一位经过培训的注释员根据抽样级别的接受或拒绝协议进行审查。
检查包括五个方面:产品忠诚、视觉可信性、运动和时间质量、销售点实现、音频质量和一致性。

blocks.en: (1) For product fidelity, the generated product is required to preserve the overall shape, proportions, colors, materials, packaging layout, logo, brand marks, and other identity-defining regions of the reference image. Videos exhibiting substantial deformation, color drift, packaging replacement, logo corruption, or cross-shot identity changes are rejected.
blocks.zh: (1)对于产品忠于性,所生成的产品需要保存参考图像的整体形状,比例,颜色,材料,包装布局,标志,品牌标志等身份界定区域. 显示大量变形,色彩漂移,包装更换,标志腐败,或跨镜头身份变化的视频被拒.

blocks.en: (2) For visual plausibility, the product, scene, and human–product interactions must remain visually and physically reasonable. We exclude samples containing severe rendering artifacts, malformed hands, object penetration, unsupported floating, inconsistent geometry, implausible liquid behavior, or incorrect spatial relations.
blocks.zh: (2) 就视觉可信性而言,产品、场景和人与产品的互动必须保持视觉和物理上的合理性。 我们排除了含有严重渲染文物,手部畸形,物体穿透,不支持漂浮,几何不一致,液体行为不可信,或空间关系不正确等样本.

blocks.en: (3) For motion and temporal quality, camera motion and object motion should remain smooth and stable within each shot, while transitions between shots should be visually natural. Videos with severe flickering, duplicated or corrupted frames, abrupt appearance changes, unstable product motion, or incoherent transitions are discarded.
blocks.zh: (3) 对于运动和时间质量而言,相机运动和物体运动在每次镜头内应保持平滑和稳定,而相机之间的相机过渡应是视相自然的. 带有严重闪烁、复制或被腐蚀的相框、突然外观变化、产品运动不稳定或过渡不协调的视频被丢弃。

blocks.en: (4) For selling-point realization, the generated content should visibly demonstrate the intended product function, characteristic, interaction, or commercial appeal specified by the plan. A sample is rejected when its central selling points are omitted, only expressed through narration, contradicted by the visual content, or replaced by unrelated actions.
blocks.zh: (4) 对于销售点实现,生成的内容应明显地表明计划所指明的预期产品功能、特性、相互作用或商业吸引力。 当其中心销售点被省略,仅以叙述方式表示,与视觉内容相矛盾,或者被不相干的行动所取而代之时,样品就被拒绝.

blocks.en: (5) For audio quality and alignment, narration and sound effects should be intelligible, semantically consistent with the planned script, and temporally aligned with the corresponding visual content. We reject videos with missing audio, severely corrupted speech, unrelated narration, substantial audio–visual mismatch, or sound effects inconsistent with the depicted actions.
blocks.zh: (5)对于音频质量和校正,叙事和音效应当通俗易懂,与规划的文字一致,时间上与相应的视觉内容一致. 我们拒绝有缺失的音频、严重腐烂的言论、无关紧要的叙事、重大的视听错配,

blocks.en: We additionally discard videos containing prominent unintended subtitles, watermarks, promotional overlays, sensitive information, or other non-product text. A video is retained only when it satisfies all five inspection aspects. The resulting synthetic subset contains 200K quality-controlled product-centric advertisement videos.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们丢弃包含突出的意料外字幕、水印、宣传上盖、敏感信息或其他非产品文本的视频。 只有符合所有五个检查要求时,才保留录像。 由此产生的合成子集包含200K质量控制的以产品为中心的广告视频.

blocks.en: A.4 Unified Annotation
blocks.zh: A.4 统一说明

blocks.en: Despite being constructed through different pipelines, the real-world and synthetic subsets share the same structured annotation format. As shown in Fig. 14 , each sample contains five components: product identity, selling points, a creative plan, an aligned audio script, and generation prompts. This unified representation allows the two subsets to be jointly used for product-centric advertisement video generation while preserving the provenance and temporal structure of each sample.
blocks.zh: 尽管是通过不同的管道来构建的,现实世界和合成子集还是有着相同的结构化注释格式. 如图14所示,每个样本包含五个组成部分:产品身份、销售点、创意计划、对齐的音频脚本和生成提示。 这种统一的表示方式使得两个子集可以共同用于以产品为中心的广告视频生成,同时保留每个样本的出处和时间结构.

blocks.en: The product-identity annotation describes both semantic identity and fine-grained visual appearance. It includes the product category, brand, and product name, together with visual attributes such as dominant colors, materials, shape, key identity regions, recognizable packaging text, and essential details that should remain unchanged throughout the video. The key_regions field records identity-defining areas such as logos, brand marks, characteristic patterns, and packaging components, while ocr_targets specifies product-related text that should remain recognizable. The must_keep field summarizes the visual elements most critical to preserving product identity.
blocks.zh: 产品标识注释既描述了语义特征,也描述了精细的视觉外观. 它包括产品类别,品牌,和产品名称,以及主色调,材料,外形,关键身份区域,可识别包装文本等视觉属性,以及在整个视频中应保持不变的基本细节. key_regions 字段记录标识,品牌标记,特征图案等身份界定区域,并记录包装组件,而ocr_targets则规定产品相关文本仍应可识别. must_keep 字段总结了对于保存产品身份最为关键的视觉元素.

blocks.en: Each selling-point entry contains the commercial feature to be communicated, its intended visual realization, and an observable success criterion. Rather than representing selling points only as textual claims, the visualization field describes how they should appear through product interactions, functional demonstrations, material details, scene design, or visible effects. The visual_success_criteria field further specifies concrete visual evidence that can be assessed from the video, enabling both generation supervision and selling-point-aware evaluation.
blocks.zh: 每个销售点条目都包含要传播的商业特征、其预期的视觉实现以及可观察到的成功标准。 可视化领域不是仅仅将销售点作为文字要求来表示,而是说明它们应该如何通过产品互动、功能演示、材料细节、场景设计或可见效果出现。 视觉_成功_标准领域进一步明确了可以从视频中评估的具体视觉证据,既能进行生成监督,又能进行销售点感评价.

blocks.en:
The creative plan organizes the advertisement at the scene, style, and shot levels. The scene annotation describes the environment and contextual presentation of the product, while the style annotation specifies the intended visual tone, including lighting, color palette, contrast, texture, and commercial aesthetics. Both fields include observable success criteria to reduce ambiguity.
The shot sequence provides a temporally ordered description of the advertisement narrative. Each shot is associated with a unique identifier, time interval, shot type, camera-motion type, visual description, intent, and visual success criterion. The selling_point_indices field explicitly links each shot to the selling points it presents. This linkage makes it possible to determine not only whether a selling point is included in the advertisement plan, but also when and how it is visually communicated. Shot intervals are ordered, non-overlapping, and jointly cover the complete video duration.
blocks.zh:
创意计划在现场,风格,和镜头级别组织广告. 场景注解描述了产品的环境和背景呈现,而风格注解则指定了预期的视觉语气,包括照明,彩色调色板,对比,纹理等,以及商业美学. 这两个领域都包括可观察到的成功标准,以减少模糊性。
镜头序列提供了按时间顺序对广告叙事的描述. 每个镜头都与独特的标识符,时间间隔,镜头类型,相机动作类型,视觉描述,意图,和视觉成功标准相接. 销售_点_indices 字段明确将每个镜头与它呈现的销售点联系起来. 这种联系不仅可以确定广告计划是否包括了销售点,而且可以确定销售点何时以及如何在视觉上传播。 拍摄间隔是命令的,不重叠,并共同覆盖整个视频持续时间.

blocks.en:
The audio script is organized according to the shot sequence. Each entry contains a shot identifier, temporal interval, background sound, and narration. This shot-level alignment associates spoken commercial messages and relevant sound effects with the corresponding visual content, supporting audio-conditioned generation and fine-grained audio–visual evaluation.
For real-world advertisements, narration is derived from timestamped ASR transcripts and aligned with detected shots. For synthetic advertisements, the narration and sound instructions are jointly planned with the visual content.
blocks.zh:
音频脚本按照镜头顺序排列. 每个条目都包含一个镜头标识符,时间间隔,背景声音,和叙述. 这种镜头级的对接将口语商业信息和相关声音效果与相应的视觉内容联系在一起,支持有音频条件的生成和精细的视听评价.
对于真实世界的广告,叙述取自被打上时间戳的ASR记录并配合被探测到的镜头. 对于合成广告,叙述和音响说明与视觉内容共同规划.

blocks.en: In addition to the structured fields, each sample provides executable video and audio generation prompts. The video-generation prompt converts the creative plan into a coherent shot-by-shot description of the scene, composition, camera behavior, product interaction, and selling-point presentation. The audio-generation prompt specifies shot-aligned narration and sound effects. These prompts serve as model-ready textual conditions, while the structured annotations retain fine-grained supervision and support diagnostic evaluation.
blocks.zh: 除了结构化的字段,每个样本还提供可执行的视频和音频生成提示. 视频生成即时将创意计划转换为对场景,组成,相机行为,产品互动,以及销售点的连贯的逐一镜头描述. 音频生成快取指定了相接的描述和声音效果. 这些提示是可供模型使用的文字条件,而结构化的说明保留了精细的监督和支持诊断评价.

blocks.en:
The two subsets differ in how their annotations are obtained but not in their final representation. For real-world samples, product identity, selling points, scene, style, and shot designs are inferred from the reference image, sampled video frames, product metadata, detected shot boundaries, and timestamped transcript. The annotations therefore describe content already present in the source advertisement. For synthetic samples, the same fields are planned from the product reference and metadata before video generation, and the corresponding visual and audio prompts are generated jointly with the structured annotations.
All annotations are normalized to the schema in Fig. 14 . We validate required fields, shot ordering, temporal coverage, selling-point references, and cross-field consistency before including a sample in AdSpark-300K. This shared representation enables unified training across real-world and synthetic data and supports tasks ranging from reference-conditioned video generation and product-identity preservation to selling-point visualization, multi-shot advertisement planning, and audio–visual generation.
blocks.zh:
这两个子集在说明的获得方式上不同,但在最后表述上不同. 对于真实世界的样本,产品身份,销售点,场景,风格,和镜头设计,从参考图像,被抽样的视频帧,产品元数据,被检测出镜头边界,以及被时间标注的笔录中推断出来. 因此,说明描述了来源广告中已经出现的内容。 对于合成样本,在视频生成前从产品参考和元数据中规划出相同的字段,相应的视觉和音频提示与结构化说明一起生成.
所有注解都与图14的图案一致。 我们在AdSpark-300K中加入一个样本之前,先验证所需字段,拍摄顺序,时间覆盖,销售点参考,以及跨战地一致性. 这种共享的表达方式使得整个现实世界和合成数据的统一培训得以实现,并支持各种任务,从有参考条件的视频生成和产品标识保存到销售点可视化、多镜头广告规划和视听生成。

blocks.en: A.5 Dataset Statistics and Distributions
blocks.zh: A.5 数据集统计和分布

blocks.en: We further analyze the video content of AdSpark-300K in Fig. 5 . At the shot level, tracking shots and dolly-in motions dominate the camera-motion distribution, accounting for 38.1% and 35.2%, respectively, followed by rack focus at 13.6%. This indicates that the dataset primarily favors smooth subject following and gradual visual emphasis, which are well suited to product-centric presentation. In terms of shot types, demonstration shots are the most frequent, followed by hero shots, macro-detail shots, and full-product shots, reflecting the importance of functional visualization and fine-grained product presentation in advertisement videos. Most products are associated with two or three selling points, while cases with more than three are relatively rare, suggesting that the advertisements generally focus on a compact set of core commercial messages. The prompt-length distribution peaks at around 500 characters while covering a wide range, reflecting diverse levels of scene detail, shot complexity, and selling-point presentation across the dataset.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步分析AdSpark-300K在图5中的视频内容. 在镜头一级,跟踪镜头和多利-入射运动在相机-运动分布中占据主导地位,分别占38.1%和35.2%,其次是13.6%的架焦. 这表明数据集主要偏好顺畅的主题,并逐渐地强调视觉,这非常适合以产品为中心的演示。 在射击类型方面,示范镜头最为常见,其次是英雄镜头,宏观细节镜头,以及全产品镜头等,反映了功能可视化和精致产品展示在广告视频中的重要性. 大多数产品都与两到三个销售点有关,而超过三个销售点的案例相对少见,说明广告一般侧重于一套紧凑的核心商业信息. 迅速长的分布峰值为500个左右的字符,同时涵盖范围很广,反映了不同程度的场景细节,拍摄复杂性,以及整个数据集的销售点呈现.

blocks.en: Figure 6: Representative reference images from AdSpark-Bench. We show benchmark reference products across diverse categories, including home appliances, electronics, clothing, furniture, food, personal care, and industrial supplies.
blocks.zh: 图6:AdSpark-Bench的代表参考图像。 我们显示不同类别的基准参考产品,包括家用电器、电子产品、服装、家具、食品、个人护理和工业用品。

blocks.en: A.6 Representative Samples
blocks.zh: A.6 代表样本

blocks.en: Figure 7: Qualitative examples from AdSpark-300K. Each row presents a reference product image and paired advertisement video frames sampled in temporal order.
blocks.zh: 图7:AdSpark-300K的定性实例。 每行呈现一个参考产品图像,并按时间顺序抽取成对的广告视频帧.

blocks.en: B.1 Benchmark Construction
blocks.zh: B.1 基准建设

blocks.en:
AdSpark-Bench is constructed from held-out product SKUs to provide a reliable evaluation suite for product-centric advertisement video generation. We randomly select 350 SKUs from the eligible product pool while ensuring that all benchmark samples are strictly SKU-disjoint from the AdSpark-300K training set. Each selected SKU contains a high-quality reference image, complete advertisement annotations, and structured generation conditions, including product identity, selling points, creative plans, and audio scripts.
To ensure evaluation reliability, we apply several filtering criteria during benchmark construction. We retain products with a single dominant object, high visual quality, clear product identity, and complete annotation schemas. Samples with low-resolution reference images, ambiguous product categories, missing metadata, or unsuitable generation conditions are removed through manual inspection. Furthermore, we restrict the benchmark to one sample per fine-grained product category (SKU category level) to reduce redundancy and improve evaluation diversity.
The final benchmark contains 220 product-conditioned cases covering 40 product categories and 220 distinct sub-categories. Following the planned advertisement structure, the benchmark includes 45 one-shot, 131 two-shot, and 44 three-shot cases, resulting in 175 multi-shot cases for evaluating cross-shot consistency, transition quality, and narrative coherence.
blocks.zh:

为确保评价的可靠性,我们在基准构建过程中采用了若干过滤标准。 我们保留了具有单一主体,高视觉质量,清晰产品特性的产品,并完成注释计划. 具有低分辨率参考图像、模棱两可的产品类别、缺失元数据或不适当的生成条件的样本通过人工检查去除。 此外,我们把基准限制在每类精细产品(SKU类)一个样本,以减少冗余和改进评价多样性。
最终基准包括220个有产品条件的案例,涉及40个产品类别和220个不同的子类别。 遵循规划的广告结构,基准包括45个一发,131个二发和44个三发病例,导致175个多发案例用于评价交叉一发的一致性,过渡质量,以及叙事一致性.

blocks.en: B.2 Category and Difficulty Distribution
blocks.zh: B.2 类别和难以分配

blocks.en:
AdSpark-Bench is designed to cover diverse product categories and generation difficulties. As shown in Fig. 6 , the benchmark spans all 40 product categories in AdSpark-300K, including electronics, beauty products, clothing, furniture, kitchenware, and beverages. Category selection follows the natural distribution of available products while maintaining coverage for long-tail categories through category-level balancing.
Beyond category diversity, we explicitly consider generation difficulty factors that are critical for product-centric advertisement generation. The benchmark contains diverse visual challenges, including fine-grained product details, packaging text preservation, logo recognition, multi-shot storytelling, and product-motion interaction. We further maintain a balanced shot-complexity distribution, where one-shot cases evaluate basic product preservation, while two-shot and three-shot cases introduce additional challenges in shot transition, temporal consistency, and narrative progression.
These design choices enable AdSpark-Bench to evaluate not only general video generation quality, but also the capability of models to preserve product identity and realize advertisement-oriented creative intentions under different levels of difficulty.
blocks.zh:
AdSpark-Bench旨在涵盖不同的产品类别和生成困难. 如图6所示,该基准涵盖AdSpark-300K的所有40个产品类别,包括电子产品、美容产品、服装、家具、厨房用具和饮料。 类别选择遵循现有产品的自然分布,同时通过类别级平衡保持对长尾类的覆盖.
除了类别多样性之外,我们明确考虑对以产品为中心的广告制作至关重要的生成困难因素。 该基准包含多种视觉挑战,包括细纹产品细节,包装文本保存,标识识别,多镜头故事讲述,以及产品-动作交互. 我们进一步保持了均衡的射击-复杂分布,即一发式病例评价基本产品保存情况,而二发式和三发式病例则在射击过渡、时间一致性和叙事进展方面带来更多挑战。
这些设计选择使得AdSpark-Bench不仅能够评价一般的视频生成质量,而且能够评价模型在不同难度水平下保存出产品特性并实现以广告为导向的创意意图的能力.

blocks.en: B.3 Conditional Evaluation Subsets
blocks.zh: B.3 有条件评价子集

blocks.en:
Some advertisement-specific metrics require specific visual conditions to provide reliable measurements. Therefore, AdSpark-Bench adopts a conditional evaluation protocol, where metrics are computed on the complete benchmark whenever applicable and on dedicated subsets when additional prerequisites are required.
Specifically, we define three conditional subsets: Text Fidelity Subset. Text Fidelity requires recognizable product-related text, such as brand names or packaging descriptions. We construct a text evaluation subset containing 72 samples with sufficient and readable OCR targets. These samples satisfy the criteria of having at least four annotated OCR targets and clear packaging text visibility. Logo and Key-Region Subset. Logo and Key-Region Similarity focuses on identity-defining visual details, including logos, brand marks, and distinctive product regions. We construct this subset with 172 samples containing visible logos or clear key regions. Specifically, samples are selected based on product identity clarity, visible brand logos, and sufficient key-region annotations. Product Demonstration Subset. To evaluate challenging advertisement scenarios involving product usage and human-product interaction, we additionally construct a product demonstration subset containing 20 samples. These cases include functional demonstrations, usage scenarios, or interaction-based shots, where models are required to visualize product functions rather than only preserve product appearance.
For multi-shot related metrics, including Cross-shot Product Consistency, Transition Naturalness, and Narrative Coherence, we directly use the multi-shot subset consisting of 175 samples (131 two-shot and 44 three-shot cases). This conditional evaluation design avoids unreliable measurements caused by missing evaluation targets while enabling fine-grained analysis of model capabilities under different advertisement scenarios.

一些针对广告的衡量标准需要特定的视觉条件来提供可靠的测量. 因此,AdSpark-Bench采用了有条件的评价协议,在适用的情况下,在完整的基准上计算指标,在需要额外先决条件时,在专用子集上计算指标。

blocks.en: B.5.4 Temporal Coherence
blocks.zh: B.5.4 时间一致性

blocks.en: Temporal coherence evaluates whether generated advertisements exhibit smooth motion, stable product dynamics, natural shot transitions, and limited temporal artifacts. Since advertisement videos often contain intentional shot cuts, all temporal metrics are computed in a shot-aware manner to avoid mistaking designed transitions for temporal inconsistency.
blocks.zh: 时间一致性评价生成的广告是否表现出平滑的动作,稳定的产品动态,自然的瞬间过渡,以及有限的时间文物. 由于广告视频中往往包含有意的镜头剪接,所以所有时间度量标准都是以有镜头意识的方式计算的,以避免因时间不一致而误认为设计的过渡.

blocks.en: Given the detected shot sequence, we evaluate temporal coherence from three perspectives: intra-shot motion quality, transition naturalness, and local temporal consistency around shot boundaries. The evaluation protocol is summarized in Algorithm 3 . All temporal coherence metrics are reported independently without aggregating them into a weighted score.

blocks.en: B.5.5 Audio Alignment

blocks.en: Audio alignment evaluates whether the generated audio is consistent with the intended advertisement design. Since not all video generation models support audio generation, this dimension is computed only for videos with valid audio outputs. We evaluate audio alignment from two complementary aspects: background sound consistency and narration script consistency.
blocks.zh: 音频对接评价生成的音频是否与预期的广告设计一致. 由于并非所有的视频生成模型都支持音频生成,因此这个维度只用于具有有效音频输出的视频. 我们从两个相辅相成的方面来评价音频对齐:背景声音的一致性和叙述脚本的一致性。

blocks.en: Background Sound Consistency measures whether the generated background audio matches the expected audio description in the creative plan. Narration Script Consistency evaluates whether the spoken narration follows the provided audio script. The overall evaluation protocol is summarized in Algorithm 4 . All audio alignment metrics are reported independently.
blocks.zh: 背景声音一致性测量生成的背景音频是否与创作计划中的预期音频描述相匹配. 叙述脚本一致性评价口语叙述是否遵循所提供的音频脚本. 总体评价规程摘要见Agorithm 4。 所有音频校正度量衡都独立报告.

blocks.en: B.5.6 Advertisement Effectiveness
blocks.zh: B.5.6 广告效果

blocks.en: Advertisement effectiveness evaluates whether a generated video functions well as a product advertisement, beyond low-level visual quality and instruction following. A video may preserve the product and follow the prompt, but still fail to attract customers, present the selling point persuasively, or form a coherent advertisement narrative. Therefore, AdSpark-Bench evaluates advertisement effectiveness from a customer-oriented perspective.
blocks.zh: 广告效果评价所生成的视频功能以及产品广告是否超越了低水平的视觉质量和随后的指令. 视频可能保存产品并遵循即时信息,但仍无法吸引顾客,无法令人信服地呈现销售点,或形成连贯的广告叙事. 因此,AdSpark-Bench从面向客户的角度评价广告的有效性.

blocks.en: We employ GPT-5.5 as a potential customer evaluator. Given the reference product, creative plan, selling points, and sampled frames from the generated video, GPT-5.5 assigns scores to three dimensions: Advertisement Attractiveness, Creative Quality, and Narrative Coherence. The evaluation protocol is summarized in Algorithm 5 . These three metrics are reported independently without aggregating them into an overall score.
blocks.zh: 我们雇用GPT-5.5作为潜在的客户评估员. 鉴于参考产品,创意计划,销售分数,以及从所生成的视频中取出样本的帧,GPT-5.5将分数分配到三个维度: 广告吸引力、创造性质量和叙述一致性。 评价协议摘要见算法5。 这三个衡量标准独立报告,但没有将它们汇总为总分.

blocks.en: B.6 Multimodal Judge Prompts
blocks.zh: B.6 多式联运法官提示

blocks.en:
Several metrics in AdSpark-Bench require high-level multimodal reasoning that cannot be reliably captured by low-level visual features or automatic detectors alone. We therefore use GPT-5.5 as a multimodal judge for selected advertisement-specific metrics, including Shot Execution Alignment, Content Alignment, Transition Naturalness, and Advertisement Effectiveness.
All multimodal judge prompts follow a unified evaluation format. The judge receives temporally ordered frames or shot-level contact sheets together with the corresponding structured annotations, such as planned shot type, motion type, scene, style, selling points, and shot descriptions. For Likert-based prompts, GPT-5.5 outputs integer scores from 1 to 5, where 1 indicates poor or missing realization, 3 indicates partial realization, and 5 indicates strong realization. These scores are linearly mapped to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] for reporting. For transition naturalness and narrative coherence, the judge directly outputs a scalar score in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] . All prompts require strict JSON or numeric-only outputs to ensure reliable parsing and reproducibility. Representative prompt templates are provided in Fig. 25 –Fig. 31 .
blocks.zh:
在AdSpark-Bench中的一些度量衡要求高层次的多模式推理,这些推理单靠低水平的视觉特征或自动探测器无法可靠地捕捉到. 因此,我们使用GPT-5.5作为特定广告计量的多模式法官,包括Shot Enterpression、内容一致、过渡自然性和广告有效性。
所有多式联运法官都采用统一的评价格式。 裁判员收到按时间顺序订购的相框或相片级接触表以及相应的结构化说明,如计划中的相片类型,动作类型,场景,风格,发售分数,相片描述等. 对于基于likrt的提示,GPT-5.5输出整数分数从1到5,其中1表示实现差或缺失,3表示部分实现,5表示强烈实现. 这些分数被线性地映射到[0, 1] [0, 1]用于报告. 对于过渡自然性和叙事一致性,法官直接以 [0, 1] [0, 1] 的分数输出出分数. 所有提示都需要严格的JSON或只用数字输出,以确保可靠的解析和再出. 图25-图31提供了代表即时模板。

blocks.en: Although GPT-5.5 is used in both synthetic advertisement planning and selected benchmark metrics, this does not constitute direct self-evaluation, as the two stages serve fundamentally different roles and operate on different inputs. During data construction, GPT-5.5 performs language-based creative planning from product references, metadata, and selling points to produce structured advertisement instructions. During evaluation, it instead performs multimodal reasoning over independently generated visual evidence, including sampled frames, shot-level contact sheets, and motion cues, to assess how well a generated video realizes a fixed product reference and advertisement plan. Therefore, the evaluation is grounded in the generated visual content rather than textual similarity to the planner output. For each benchmark case, all evaluated video generation models are conditioned on exactly the same reference image and advertisement prompt, such that the conditioning information is held constant across methods. We further validate the GPT-assisted metrics independently against human judgments in Sup. B.8 .
blocks.zh: 虽然GPT-5.5既用于合成广告规划,也用于选定的基准度量标准,但这并不构成直接的自我评价,因为这两个阶段的作用根本不同,运作在不同的投入上. 在数据构建过程中,GPT-5.5从产品参考文献,元数据和销售点进行基于语言的创造性规划,以制作结构化广告说明. 在评价期间,它进行多种方式的推理,而不是独立生成的视觉证据,包括被取样的相框、相片级接触表和运动提示,以评估生成的视频在多大程度上实现了固定产品参考和广告计划。 因此,评价的基础是产生的视觉内容,而不是与规划员产出的文字相似。 对于每个基准案例,所有被评价的视频生成模型都以完全相同的参考图像和广告的即时性为条件,从而使各种方法的调值信息保持不变。 在Sup.B.8中,我们进一步独立地验证了全球预防酷刑援助的衡量标准。

blocks.en: B.8 Metric Validation
blocks.zh: B.8 计量验证

blocks.en:
We validate the GPT-assisted metrics of AdSpark-Bench by measuring their agreement with human rankings. Specifically, we focus on the six metrics that involve GPT-based judgment: Shot Execution Alignment, Content Alignment, Transition Naturalness, Advertisement Attractiveness, Creative Quality, and Narrative Coherence. These metrics cover instruction following, selling-point realization, transition quality, commercial appeal, creative quality, and multi-shot storytelling. To conduct this validation, we construct an additional evaluation set outside AdSpark-Bench, consisting of 100 held-out products. For each product, all evaluated models are used to generate advertisement videos under the same product reference and advertisement prompt. GPT-5.5 then assigns a score to each generated video along the six GPT-assisted dimensions according to the evaluation protocols defined in AdSpark-Bench.
In parallel, we recruit six human raters with research backgrounds in video generation and advertisement-related research to independently evaluate the same generated videos using an aligned six-dimensional rubric. Each video is rated by multiple raters, and all raters are blinded to the identity of the generation model and the corresponding GPT-5.5 scores.
blocks.zh:
我们通过测量其与人类排名的一致,验证了AdSpark-Bench的GPT辅助度量. 具体地说,我们侧重于涉及基于GBT的判断的六个衡量标准:射击执行一致、内容一致、过渡自然、广告吸引力、创造性质量和叙述一致性。 这些衡量标准包括后续指导、销售点实现、过渡质量、商业吸引力、创造性质量和多镜头讲故事。 为了进行这一验证,我们在AdSpark-Bench之外建造了由100个被搁置的产品组成的额外评价组。 对每种产品,所有评价模型都用于在同一产品参考和广告提示下制作广告录像。 然后,GPT-5.5根据AdSpark-Bench定义的评价协议,沿GPT辅助的6个维度为每个生成的视频分配一个分数.
与此同时,我们招募了6名具有视频制作和广告相关研究背景的人类评分员,用一个对齐的六维分数独立评价同样生成的视频. 每段视频均被多位评分者评分,所有评分者都对生成模型的身份和相应的GPT-5.5分数视而不见.

Tied scores are assigned average ranks. For each product p p and dimension d d , we compute Spearman’s rank correlation between the human ranking and the metric ranking: ρ p d = Spearman ⁡ ( { r p , k d , h } k = 1 K , { r p , k d , m } k = 1 K ) . \rho_{p}^{d}=\mathrm{Spearman}\left(\{r_{p,k}^{d,h}\}_{k=1}^{K},\{r_{p,k}^{d,m}\}_{k=1}^{K}\right).
