blocks.en: C.1 Details of Evaluation Models
blocks.zh: C.1 评价模式的细节

blocks.en: We evaluate representative reference-to-video generation models on AdSpark-Bench, covering both proprietary and open-source models.
blocks.zh: 我们评价在AdSpark-Bench上具有代表性的参考到视频生成模型,既包括专有模型,也包括开源模型.

blocks.en: We include seven proprietary video generation systems. ViduQ2 and ViduQ3 are reference-conditioned video generation models from the Vidu series, supporting image-guided generation and multi-reference conditioning. ViduQ3 further supports native audio-video generation and places greater emphasis on complex motion and cinematic storytelling. Seedance 2.0 Seedance et al. (2026) is a unified multimodal audio-video generation model that accepts text, image, video, and audio references, enabling reference-guided generation with native audio. HappyHorse-1.1 is a joint audio-video generation model supporting text-to-video, image-to-video, and reference-to-video generation. PixVerse V5 and PixVerse V6 are general-purpose video generation systems supporting image-conditioned synthesis, while the latter additionally provides more flexible reference-based generation and video extension capabilities. Kling 3.0 Omni Team et al. (2025) is a multimodal video generation system that unifies reference-guided generation, video editing, and visual-language instruction following.
blocks.zh: 我们包括7个专有视频生成系统。 ViduQ2和ViduQ3是Vidu系列的参考条件视频生成模型,支持图像引导生成和多参考配置. ViduQ3进一步支持本土音频-视频生成,并更强调复杂的运动和电影故事讲述. 种子2.0种子等 (2026)是一种统一的多模式音频-视频生成模式,它接受文字,图像,视频,和音频引用,能够以本土音频进行参考引导生成. HappyHorse-1.1是一个支持文本到视频,图像到视频,以及参考到视频生成的联合音频-视频生成模型. PixVerse V5和PixVerse V6是支持图像条件合成的通用视频生成系统,而后者又提供了更灵活的基于参考的生成和视频扩展能力. Kling 3.0 Omni Team et al. (2025)是一个多模式视频生成系统,它统一了参考引导生成,视频编辑,以及随后的视觉语言教学.

blocks.en:
We further evaluate eleven open-source models with different reference-conditioning mechanisms. VACE-14B Jiang et al. (2025) unifies reference-to-video generation and multiple video editing tasks through a shared video-conditioning interface. SkyReels-V3-14B Li et al. (2026) adopts a multimodal in-context generation framework and supports reference-image-to-video generation, video extension, and audio-guided synthesis. Phantom-14B Liu et al. (2025) performs single- and multi-subject video generation through joint text–image conditioning and cross-modal alignment. VINO-13B Chen et al. (2026) is a unified visual generation model that handles interleaved multimodal conditions for controllable image and video synthesis. RefAlign-14B Wang et al. (2026a) explicitly aligns reference-branch representations with visual foundation model features to improve reference fidelity and reduce subject confusion. Kaleido-14B Zhang et al. (2025) targets multi-subject reference video generation and introduces reference-aware positional encoding for stable multi-image conditioning. HunyuanCustom-13B Hu et al. (2025) is a customized video generation framework that integrates multimodal reference information to preserve target subject characteristics. Bernini-14B Team et al. (2026) employs latent semantic planning to improve compositional organization and semantic control during video generation. MV-S2V-14B Song et al. (2026) conditions generation on multiple views of a target subject to improve three-dimensional subject consistency. MAGREF-14B Deng et al. (2025) introduces masked reference guidance for flexible any-reference video generation.
Finally, LTX-2-14B HaCohen et al. (2026) is an efficient joint audio-video foundation model supporting synchronized visual and audio generation.
blocks.zh:
我们进一步评估11个具有不同参考调节机制的开源模型。 VACE-14B (中文(简体) ). Jiang等 (2025)通过共享视频空调接口统一了参考到视频生成和多视频编辑任务. 天线-V3-14B Li等 (2026年)采用了多模式内文本生成框架,并支持参考-图像到视频生成,视频扩展和音频导合成. 幽灵14B 刘等. (2025)通过联合文本-图像配置和跨模式对接,进行单题和多题视频生成. VINO-13B (韩语) Chen等 (2026)是一种统一的可视生成模型,处理可控图像和视频合成的互放多式条件. 反对号-14B Wang等 (2026a)明确将参考-分支表示与视觉地基模型特征相协调,以提高参考忠心度并减少主题混淆. 卡莱多-14B 张等 (2025年)以多主体参考视频生成为目标,并引入了稳定多图像配置的参考-认知定位编码. 湖南海关-13B Hu等 (2025)是一个定制的视频生成框架,集成多模式参考信息,以保持目标主题特征. 贝尔尼尼-14B Team等人(2026年)采用潜在的语义规划,在视频生成过程中改善组成组织和语义控制. MV-S2V-14B型电力机车 Song等 (2026) 条件生成一个目标对象的多视图,以提高三维主题的一致性. MAGREF-14B (英语: 邓等. (2025)引入了有遮蔽的参考指导,用于任何参考视频的灵活生成.
最后,LTX-2-14B HaCohen等 (2026)是一个高效的联合音频-视频基础模型,支持同步的视觉和音频生成.

blocks.en: For fair comparison, all models are evaluated using the same product reference images and advertisement prompts from AdSpark-Bench whenever their interfaces support reference-conditioned generation. We follow the official inference settings of each model. For models without audio generation capability, audio-related metrics are marked as unavailable rather than assigned zero scores.
blocks.zh: 为了进行公平比较,只要AdSpark-Bench的接口支持有参考条件的生成,就使用同样的产品参考图像和广告提示对所有模型进行评价。 我们遵循每个模型的官方推论设置。 对于没有音频生成能力的模型,音频相关度量标准被标记为无法使用,而不是指定为零分.

blocks.en: C.2 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: C.2 执行细节

blocks.en: We fine-tune LTX-2 as the AdSpark-adapted baseline, denoted as LTX-AdSpark, to validate the effectiveness of AdSpark-300K. We use LTX-2 as the base model and adopt LoRA training instead of full-parameter fine-tuning for efficient adaptation.
blocks.zh: 我们微调了LTX-2作为AdSpark调整后的基线,表示为LTX-AdSpark,以验证AdSpark-300K的有效性. 我们使用LTX-2作为基准模型,并采用LORA训练,而不是全参数的微调来进行高效改造.

blocks.en: LoRA is applied to the attention projection layers, including to_q , to_k , and to_v . The LoRA rank and alpha are both set to 64, with dropout set to 0. The model is trained for 30K steps using AdamW with a learning rate of 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} , batch size 4, gradient clipping of 1.0, and bfloat16 mixed precision. Gradient checkpointing is enabled during training.
blocks.zh: LoRA被应用于注意投影层,包括到_q,到_k,到_v. LORA级和α级均被设定为64级,辍学率被设定为0级. 该型号使用 AdamW 为 30K 级进行训练,学习率为 2× 10− 4 2\times 10× 4} 分批大小 4,梯度剪接为 1.0,并有 bfloat16 混合精度. 训练期间可以进行分步检查。

blocks.en: During training and inference, the model uses the product reference image as the primary visual condition and the structured advertisement prompt as textual guidance. Video and audio latents are precomputed from AdSpark-300K, while audio generation is learned from text supervision without reference audio conditioning.
blocks.zh: 在培训和推论期间,该模型以产品参考图像作为主要视觉条件,并用结构化的广告即时作为文字指导. 视频和音频潜入从AdSpark-300K预先计算,而音频生成则从文本监管中学习而无参考音频调取.

blocks.en: For validation and benchmark inference, we generate 9:16 advertisement videos at 704 × 1280 704\times 1280 resolution with 121 frames at 24 fps, corresponding to approximately 5 seconds. We use 30 inference steps, guidance scale 4.0, STG scale 1.0, and a fixed random seed of 42. Checkpoints are saved every 1,000 steps, and validation is performed every 3,000 steps.
blocks.zh: 为了验证和基准推论,我们以704×1280 704\times 1280分辨率生成了9:16的广告视频,其中121帧为24 fps,对应约5秒. 我们使用30个推断步骤,指向比分4.0,STG比分1.0,以及42个固定随机种子. 检查点每1000个步骤被保存,每3000个步骤被执行验证.

blocks.en: C.3 Qualitative Comparisons
blocks.zh: C.3 定性比较

blocks.en: We provide additional qualitative comparisons on AdSpark-Bench in Fig. 9 -Fig. 11 . Each example uses the same product reference image and structured advertisement prompt across all models. The results show that existing models can generally synthesize plausible video, but they still struggle with fine-grained product preservation, interaction realism, and shot-level prompt following. For instance, several methods change the geometry or material details of the clothes-drying rack, distort the drawer structure of the wooden desk, or fail to preserve the bracelet shape and pendant details in close-up shots. Some models also introduce inconsistent hands, abrupt viewpoint changes, or weak correspondence between the planned demonstration and the generated motion. In comparison, LTX-AdSpark produces more product-consistent results with smoother shot progression and clearer selling-point presentation, indicating that AdSpark-300K improves reference-conditioned advertisement video generation in product-centric scenarios.
blocks.zh: 我们在图9-图11中提供了AdSpark-Bench的更多定性比较。每个例子都使用相同的产品参考图像和所有模型上所提示的结构化广告。 结果显示,现有的模型一般可以合成可信的视频,但它们仍然与精细的分泌产品保存,互动现实主义,以及镜头级的即时跟踪相争. 例如,几种方法改变了衣服干燥架的几何或材料细节,扭曲了木制桌子的抽屉结构,或者未能在特写镜头中保存手镯形状和相接细节. 一些模型还引入了不连贯的手,突然的视角变化,或者计划中的演示和所生成的运动之间的微弱对应. 相较之下,LTX-AdSpark以更平滑的镜头进取和更清晰的发售点呈现方式产生出更符合产品要求的结果,表明AdSpark-300K在以产品为中心的情景中改善了参考条件的广告视频生成.

blocks.zh: C.4. 结果

blocks.en:
To disentangle the effects of data composition and dataset scale, we further fine-tune LTX-2 on different subsets of AdSpark-300K under identical optimization settings. As shown in Tab. 6 , both real-world and synthetic advertisements consistently improve over the base model, while exhibiting complementary strengths.
We first compare Real-100K and Synthetic-100K under the same training scale, where Synthetic-100K is randomly sampled from the full 200K synthetic subset. The two subsets show different strengths. Real-world data performs better on Subject Consistency (64.73 vs. 58.17), suggesting that authentic product appearances provide stronger identity supervision. Synthetic data is more effective on structure- and transition-related metrics, reaching 71.79 on Shot Structure Alignment, 80.09 on Transition Naturalness, and 81.38 on Narration Script Consistency, compared with 70.68, 72.76, and 78.26 for Real-100K. This is consistent with its construction from explicit shot-level plans and aligned narration instructions.
Scaling the synthetic subset from 100K to 200K brings further gains across all reported metrics, showing that data scale also contributes. Nevertheless, the full AdSpark-300K performs best overall. In particular, adding 100K real-world samples on top of Synthetic-200K raises Subject Consistency from 61.59 to 65.01 and further improves the remaining metrics. These results suggest that the final performance gains come from both increased training scale and the complementary supervision of the real-world and synthetic subsets.
blocks.zh:
为了分解数据构成和数据集尺度的影响,我们在相同的优化设置下,进一步微调AdSpark-300K的不同子集的LTX-2. 如塔布所显示. 6,真实世界和合成广告均比基准模型不断改进,同时表现出互补优势.
我们首先比较Real-100K和Synthetic-100K在同一训练尺度下,其中Synthetic-100K从完整的200K合成子集中随机抽取. 这两个子集显示了不同的长处. 真实世界的数据在主题一致性(64.73 vs 58.17)方面表现较好,表明真实产品外观可提供更强大的身份监督. 合成数据在结构和过渡相关计量方面更为有效,在Shot结构对接方面达到71.79个,在过渡自然方面达到80.09个,在叙述脚本一致性方面达到81.38个,而Real-100K方面则达到70.68、72.76和78.26个。 这与根据明确的射平平图和一致的叙述指示来构建它是一致的。
将合成子集从100K扩大至200K,使所有已报告的衡量标准都取得进一步收益,表明数据规模也有所贡献。 尽管如此,AdSpark-300K的全程总体表现最好. 特别是,在Synthetic-200K上方添加了100K个真实世界的样本,使主体一致性从61.59提高到65.01,并进一步改善了其余的度量. 这些结果表明,最终的业绩收益来自培训规模的扩大以及对现实世界和合成子集的补充监督。

blocks.en: Appendix D Broader Impact and Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录D 更广泛的影响和限制

blocks.en: D.1 Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: D.1 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: AdSpark provides an important step toward product-centric advertisement video generation, while leaving several directions for future extension. First, the current dataset is constructed from e-commerce scenarios. Future work could extend the data sources to more diverse platforms, markets, and advertising styles. Second, our product selection is mainly guided by click-through rate, which helps prioritize representative and commercially relevant products with strong user interest. At the same time, future extensions could further cover a broader long-tail product distribution, including niche categories and less frequently promoted products, to support more comprehensive evaluation and generation across diverse product types.
blocks.zh: AdSpark为以产品为核心的广告视频制作提供了重要的一步,同时为未来的扩展留下了几个方向. 首先,目前的数据集是根据电子商务情景构建的。 今后的工作可以将数据来源扩展到更多样化的平台、市场和广告风格。 第二,我们的产品选择主要以点击率为指导,这有助于确定具有很大用户兴趣的代表性和商业相关产品的优先顺序。 同时,今后的扩展可以进一步涵盖更广泛的长尾产品分销,包括特殊类别和较少推广的产品,以支持对不同类型产品进行更全面的评价和生成。
